stances.quote: I also serve as Chairman of the Military and Foreign Affairs Oversight Subcommittee. In this role, I focus on strengthening America’s national security by ensuring our servicemembers have the resources, readiness, and leadership they need to remain the most lethal fighting force in the world.
stances.reasoning: The statement explicitly calls for ensuring servicemembers have the resources needed to maintain the most lethal force, indicating support for increased military resources and spending.

stances.quote: Additionally, last summer, Republicans voted to deliver the largest tax cut in American history, increasing Americans’ take-home pay by up to $13,300.
stances.reasoning: The text praises the largest tax cut and commits to reducing spending while highlighting tax relief, showing clear support for lower taxes.

stances.quote: I will continue to reject policies that fuel Washington’s out-of-control spending habits and instead support efforts to reduce spending, rein in the federal bureaucracy... In Congress, I have consistently stood against wasteful government spending.
